title: John the Baptist Preaches Repentance
description: John, the son of Zechariah, preaches a baptism of repentance in the wilderness around the Jordan and calls people to bear fruit that matches their repentance. He gives practical advice to the crowds, tax collectors, and soldiers, pointing forward to someone stronger who will baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire. Finally, he is thrown into prison by Herod after rebuking him [ref:Luk 3:1-20|Luke 3:1-20].
